Add rendering columns to a report's item table

Source: R/instar_report.R
dot-render_data.Rd

Derives the display string, colour, and font face for each item from its value and status. Kept separate from instar_report() so that the report object stays free of presentation detail.

Usage

.render_data(report)

Arguments

report

An object of class instar_report.

Value

A data frame ready for .build_figure().
